# Quirk Skills - Agent Discovery Entrypoint

> 229 skills for AI coding agents. Source: undefined

## Quick Install

```bash
npx skills-quirk add quirk-skills
```

## Skills Index

- [accessibility](./.agents/skills/accessibility/accessibility/SKILL.md) — Design inclusive products — WCAG compliance, assistive technology support, keyboard navigation, color contrast — with explicit user access guarantees.
- [accessibility-design](./.agents/skills/accessibility/accessibility-design/SKILL.md) — Design accessible interfaces — semantics, focus management, keyboard flows, contrast, and assistive-technology compatibility — with inclusive interaction patterns.
- [accessibility-testing](./.agents/skills/accessibility/accessibility-testing/SKILL.md) — Test web interfaces for accessibility compliance — automated scans, manual keyboard navigation, screen reader validation — with explicit barrier detection and remediation evidence.
- [agent-canvas](./.agents/skills/foundation/agent-canvas/SKILL.md) — Reference skill for agent workspace control — multi-agent session management, workspace persistence, and cross-device continuity, independent of any external framework.
- [agent-observability](./.agents/skills/foundation/agent-observability/SKILL.md) — Capture redacted execution records, traces, and quality signals for skill runs with structured data for analysis. Enables full audit of decisions made during agent execution.
- [agent-orchestration](./.agents/skills/ai/agent-orchestration/SKILL.md) — Design agent orchestration — multi-agent patterns, tool use, memory, handoffs, evaluation — with explicit coordination boundaries and observability.
- [ai-ml-pipeline](./.agents/skills/ai/ai-ml-pipeline/SKILL.md) — Design ML pipelines — data ingestion, preprocessing, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring — with reproducibility, fairness, and version control.
- [ai-model-evaluation](./.agents/skills/ai/ai-model-evaluation/SKILL.md) — Evaluate ML / LLM models — accuracy, fairness, robustness, explainability, drift — with explicit metrics, subgroup analysis, and failure-mode reporting.
- [ai-prompt-engineering](./.agents/skills/ai/ai-prompt-engineering/SKILL.md) — Design, evaluate, and refine prompts for LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Llama, Mistral) with chain-of-thought, few-shot, RAG, and evaluation metrics.
- [ai-time-series-forecasting](./.agents/skills/ai/ai-time-series-forecasting/SKILL.md) — Design and evaluate time-series forecasting — ARIMA, Prophet, NeuralProphet, LSTM, Transformer — with stationarity analysis, seasonality, exogenous variables, and backtest.
- [api-contracts](./.agents/skills/integrations/api-contracts/SKILL.md) — Define the request and response contracts, versioning rules, compatibility boundaries, OpenAPI/JSON Schema, and breaking change detection for APIs — with explicit consumer obligations.
- [api-design](./.agents/skills/foundation/api-design/SKILL.md) — Design a small, durable API seam — with a deep backend and explicit caller contract boundaries.
- [api-gateway](./.agents/skills/backend/api-gateway/SKILL.md) — API gateway (Kong, Envoy, AWS API Gateway, rate limiting, auth, routing).
- [artifact-handoff](./.agents/skills/routing/artifact-handoff/SKILL.md) — Transfer structured artifacts between Skills and sessions — with explicit provenance and consumer expectations.
- [ask-to](./.agents/skills/routing/ask-to/SKILL.md) — Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo that recommends the next step after governance preflight.
- [astro](./.agents/skills/frontend/astro/SKILL.md) — Astro framework (islands architecture, content-focused sites, SSR/SSG, view transitions).
- [auth](./.agents/skills/integrations/auth/SKILL.md) — Design authentication and authorization as a small, explicit seam — with OAuth2/OIDC, MFA, passkeys, JWT, session management, and clear caller and operator responsibilities.
- [backend-architecture](./.agents/skills/backend/backend-architecture/SKILL.md) — Shape backend systems — REST/gRPC APIs, service contracts, data flow, state management, error handling — with explicit seams and caller responsibilities.
- [backend-caching](./.agents/skills/backend/backend-caching/SKILL.md) — Design backend caching strategies — cache keys, TTLs, invalidation, stale-while-revalidate, and cache coherence — with explicit consistency and failure trade-offs.
- [backend-queues](./.agents/skills/backend/backend-queues/SKILL.md) — Design backend queues and background job systems — durability, retries, ordering, idempotency, and backpressure — with explicit delivery guarantees.
- [backup-disaster-recovery](./.agents/skills/devops/backup-disaster-recovery/SKILL.md) — Design backup and disaster recovery — RPO/RTO, backup strategies, restore testing, cross-region — with explicit recovery objectives and validation.
- [caching-advanced](./.agents/skills/backend/caching-advanced/SKILL.md) — Advanced caching strategies (Redis, Memcached, CDN, cache invalidation, stampede prevention).
- [capability-router](./.agents/skills/routing/capability-router/SKILL.md) — Route work to the best matching Skill using declared capabilities and compatibility — with explicit selection rules.
- [chaos-engineering](./.agents/skills/devops/chaos-engineering/SKILL.md) — Design chaos engineering — fault injection, GameDays, resilience validation — with explicit steady-state hypotheses, blast radius controls, and safety rails.
- [cloud-security](./.agents/skills/sec/cloud-security/SKILL.md) — Cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure, IAM, KMS, security groups, compliance, posture management)
- [cms-access-control](./.agents/skills/cms/cms-access-control/SKILL.md) — Design CMS access control — roles, permissions, editorial workflows, and publishing boundaries — with explicit least-privilege and auditability.
- [cms-architecture](./.agents/skills/cms/cms-architecture/SKILL.md) — Design content management systems — content models, editorial workflows, publishing pipelines, localization — with schema evolution and multi-channel delivery.
- [cms-content-strategy](./.agents/skills/cms/cms-content-strategy/SKILL.md) — Design CMS content strategy — content models, taxonomy, governance, lifecycle, and multi-channel publishing — with explicit editorial ownership.
- [code-review](./.agents/skills/delivery/code-review/SKILL.md) — Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes - Standards and Spec - and publish findings only.
- [codebase-design](./.agents/skills/foundation/codebase-design/SKILL.md) — Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find depth, or define a clean seam.
- [compiler-design](./.agents/skills/compilers/compiler-design/SKILL.md) — Design compiler pipelines — lexing, parsing, ASTs, type checking, IR, optimization, and code generation — with correctness and modularity.
- [compiler-testing](./.agents/skills/compilers/compiler-testing/SKILL.md) — Test compilers and interpreters — parser tests, semantic tests, IR validation, golden tests, and regression checks — with explicit oracle design.
- [compilers](./.agents/skills/compilers/compilers/SKILL.md) — Design and implement compilers and interpreters — lexer, parser, AST, type checking, code generation, optimization — with correctness and modularity.
- [compliance](./.agents/skills/sec/compliance/SKILL.md) — Compliance (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, audits, evidence, remediation)
- [container-security](./.agents/skills/sec/container-security/SKILL.md) — Container security (Docker, Kubernetes, image scanning, runtime security, pod security policies)
- [context-engine](./.agents/skills/foundation/context-engine/SKILL.md) — Manage dynamic context for agent execution using retrieval-augmented generation patterns, updating the working context from sources beyond static CONTEXT.md (issues, PRs, docs, execution traces).
- [context-pack](./.agents/skills/routing/context-pack/SKILL.md) — Build a minimal fresh context pack with ordered reads and provenance — for scoped, high-signal handoff.
- [contribution-workflow-optimizer](./.agents/skills/delivery/contribution-workflow-optimizer/SKILL.md) — Inspect changed Skills and recommend contribution improvements across standards, docs, tests, and examples; use when eva
- [cost-optimization](./.agents/skills/devops/cost-optimization/SKILL.md) — Design FinOps strategies — rightsizing, spot instances, committed use, budgets, showback/chargeback — with cost visibility and optimisation guardrails.
- [cs-algorithms](./.agents/skills/cs/cs-algorithms/SKILL.md) — Design and analyse algorithms — correctness proof, complexity analysis (time and space), and stability — with explicit proof of invariants and termination.
- [cs-complexity-analysis](./.agents/skills/cs/cs-complexity-analysis/SKILL.md) — Analyze algorithmic complexity — time, space, amortized cost, and lower bounds — with explicit assumptions and proof sketches.
- [cs-computability](./.agents/skills/cs/cs-computability/SKILL.md) — Analyze computability questions — decidability, reductions, recognizability, and undecidability proofs — with formal problem transformations.
- [cs-data-structures](./.agents/skills/cs/cs-data-structures/SKILL.md) — Design and analyze data structures — arrays, trees, heaps, hash tables, graphs, and balanced variants — with operation costs and invariants.
- [data-catalog](./.agents/skills/data/data-catalog/SKILL.md) — Data catalog (metadata management, discovery, classification, data mesh, governance).
- [data-contracts](./.agents/skills/data/data-contracts/SKILL.md) — Design data contracts — schema evolution, producer-consumer agreements, schema registry, breaking change detection — with explicit compatibility rules and versioning.
- [data-etl-pipeline](./.agents/skills/data/data-etl-pipeline/SKILL.md) — Design ETL / ELT pipelines — extraction, transformation, load — with reproducible steps, schema evolution, quality checks, and observability.
- [data-lineage](./.agents/skills/data/data-lineage/SKILL.md) — Data lineage (end-to-end tracing, impact analysis, column-level lineage, governance).
- [data-quality](./.agents/skills/data/data-quality/SKILL.md) — Design data quality frameworks — Great Expectations, Soda, checks, observability, contracts — with explicit SLAs, freshness rules, and incident response for bad data.
- [data-streaming](./.agents/skills/data/data-streaming/SKILL.md) — Design streaming data pipelines — Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, Flink — with event schemas, stream processing, and real-time analytics.
- [data-versioning](./.agents/skills/data/data-versioning/SKILL.md) — Data versioning (DVC, lakeFS, delta tables, snapshotting, reproducibility).
- [data-warehouse-modeling](./.agents/skills/data/data-warehouse-modeling/SKILL.md) — Design analytical warehouse schemas — star / snowflake / OBT — with dimension, fact, and bridge tables; partitioning; indexing; and query optimization.
- [db-migrations](./.agents/skills/db/db-migrations/SKILL.md) — Plan database migrations — schema changes, backfills, compatibility windows, and rollback strategy — with explicit application and data safety checks.
- [db-nosql-modeling](./.agents/skills/db/db-nosql-modeling/SKILL.md) — Design NoSQL data models — document, key-value, wide-column, graph, time-series — with access pattern analysis, consistency requirements, and schema evolution.
- [db-query-optimization](./.agents/skills/db/db-query-optimization/SKILL.md) — Optimize database queries — indexing, query plans, cardinality, joins, and execution trade-offs — with explainable reasoning and measurement.
- [db-relational-design](./.agents/skills/db/db-relational-design/SKILL.md) — Design relational schemas — entities, relations, keys, indexes, constraints — with normalisation, performance, and migration planning.
- [design-system](./.agents/skills/frontend/design-system/SKILL.md) — Define and evolve reusable UI tokens, components, and usage rules as a coherent system.
- [devops-ci-cd-pipeline](./.agents/skills/devops/devops-ci-cd-pipeline/SKILL.md) — Design CI/CD pipelines — build, test, security scan, deploy, rollback — with reproducible steps, environment parity, and deployment gates.
- [devops-feature-flags](./.agents/skills/devops/devops-feature-flags/SKILL.md) — Design feature flag systems — gradual rollouts, A/B experiments, kill switches, targeting rules — with lifecycle management and operational runbooks.
- [devops-k8s-orchestration](./.agents/skills/devops/devops-k8s-orchestration/SKILL.md) — Design and configure Kubernetes orchestration — cluster architecture, deployment strategies, service mesh, observability, auto-scaling, security policies — with reproducible infrastructure.
- [devops-terraform-iac](./.agents/skills/devops/devops-terraform-iac/SKILL.md) — Design infrastructure as code — Terraform / Pulumi / CloudFormation — for reproducible, version-controlled, auditable cloud infrastructure.
- [diagnosing-bugs](./.agents/skills/delivery/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md) — Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something intermittent, ambiguous, or hard to reproduce.
- [distributed-tracing](./.agents/skills/backend/distributed-tracing/SKILL.md) — Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, W3C TraceContext, sampling, instrumentation).
- [docs-adrs](./.agents/skills/docs/docs-adrs/SKILL.md) — Create and maintain Architecture Decision Records — context, decision, consequences, alternatives, status — with periodic review.
- [docs-knowledge-base](./.agents/skills/docs/docs-knowledge-base/SKILL.md) — Maintain a repository knowledge base — glossary, durable references, indexed guidance, and consumer-oriented navigation — with explicit update rules.
- [docs-management](./.agents/skills/project/docs-management/SKILL.md) — Keep repository documentation, ADRs, and durable context aligned with the current project shape — with explicit consumer rules.
- [docs-technical-writing](./.agents/skills/docs/docs-technical-writing/SKILL.md) — Write technical documentation — clear explanations, examples, warnings, and procedural guidance — with audience-aware structure and maintenance rules.
- [domain-modeling](./.agents/skills/foundation/domain-modeling/SKILL.md) — Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language boundary.
- [evaluate-skill](./.agents/skills/skill-dev/evaluate-skill/SKILL.md) — Evaluate a Skill against fixed scenarios for routing, completion, and artifact validity.
- [event-driven-architecture](./.agents/skills/backend/event-driven-architecture/SKILL.md) — Event-driven architecture (Kafka, NATS, EventBridge, choreography vs orchestration).
- [execution-policy](./.agents/skills/auxiliary/execution-policy/SKILL.md) — Decide whether a Skill action is allowed, requires approval, or must stop.
- [feature-store](./.agents/skills/data/feature-store/SKILL.md) — Feature store (online/offline, feature engineering, serving, monitoring, drift).
- [finance-corporate-val](./.agents/skills/finance/finance-corporate-val/SKILL.md) — Corporate valuation — DCF, multiples, sum-of-parts, scenario analysis — with explicit assumptions, sensitivity, and cross-checks.
- [finance-dcf](./.agents/skills/finance/finance-dcf/SKILL.md) — Discounted Cash Flow — forecast, WACC, terminal value, sensitivity — with explicit assumptions, cross-check against multiples, and a valuation range.
- [finance-portfolio-theory](./.agents/skills/finance/finance-portfolio-theory/SKILL.md) — Modern Portfolio Theory — efficient frontier, CAPM, APT, risk attribution, and performance measurement — with explicit assumptions and regime analysis.
- [frontend-design](./.agents/skills/frontend/frontend-design/SKILL.md) — Shape frontend work into a clear visual system, interaction model, and implementation seam — with explicit state and motion boundaries.
- [frontend-testing](./.agents/skills/frontend/frontend-testing/SKILL.md) — Frontend testing (Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright, visual testing, Storybook).
- [gitops](./.agents/skills/devops/gitops/SKILL.md) — Design GitOps workflows — ArgoCD, Flux, declarative sync, drift detection, progressive delivery — with explicit reconciliation and safety boundaries.
- [grill](./.agents/skills/routing/grill/SKILL.md) — Alias for the quirk grilling flow. Use when the user says "grill" and wants a relentless interview to sharpen a plan, decision, or design.
- [grill-me](./.agents/skills/routing/grill-me/SKILL.md) — A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
- [grill-with-docs](./.agents/skills/routing/grill-with-docs/SKILL.md) — A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, while creating docs (ADRs and glossary) as we go.
- [grilling](./.agents/skills/routing/grilling/SKILL.md) — Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or use docs to sharpen the premise before acting.
- [grpc-connect](./.agents/skills/backend/grpc-connect/SKILL.md) — gRPC and Connect (protobuf, ConnectRPC, grpc-gateway, streaming, code generation).
- [handoff](./.agents/skills/routing/handoff/SKILL.md) — Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up — with explicit continuity and ownership notes.
- [implement](./.agents/skills/delivery/implement/SKILL.md) — Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets, or build a scoped fix that can be handed off for publication. This skill stops at the implemented, validated branch.
- [implement-review-fixes](./.agents/skills/delivery/implement-review-fixes/SKILL.md) — Read a GitHub PR remediation plan produced by plan-review-fixes, implement the planned corrections through the repositor
- [improve-codebase-architecture](./.agents/skills/engineering/improve-codebase-architecture/SKILL.md) — Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities and present candidates as a visual HTML report, then grill through the selected one.
- [incident-forensics](./.agents/skills/sec/incident-forensics/SKILL.md) — Incident forensics (evidence collection, timeline reconstruction, root cause, reporting)
- [incident-response](./.agents/skills/devops/incident-response/SKILL.md) — Design incident response — runbooks, war rooms, postmortems, blameless culture — with explicit severity taxonomy, escalation paths, and communication rules.
- [integration-playground](./.agents/skills/auxiliary/integration-playground/SKILL.md) — Create a disposable fixture environment for safely exercising Skills against local APIs, data, and files; use when testing a Skill with isolated local fixtures.
- [interaction-design](./.agents/skills/ux/interaction-design/SKILL.md) — Design user interactions — task flows, screen states, transitions, error states, feedback patterns — so the interface guides users predictably.
- [interactive-tutorial-builder](./.agents/skills/auxiliary/interactive-tutorial-builder/SKILL.md) — Generate a focused tutorial with goals, exercise inputs, expected outputs, and checkpoints for any Skill; use when teaching or onboarding someone to a Skill.
- [iot-embedded](./.agents/skills/iot/iot-embedded/SKILL.md) — Design embedded/IoT systems — firmware, sensors, edge computing, device connectivity, OTA updates — with reliability, security, and constrained resource awareness.
- [issue-operations](./.agents/skills/integrations/issue-operations/SKILL.md) — Manage issue tracker operations with scoped target resolution, duplicate checks, mutation evidence, and rollback notes for create, update, comment, label, link, assign, and close actions.
- [knowledge-curator](./.agents/skills/routing/knowledge-curator/SKILL.md) — Keep context, ADRs, registry entries, and research coherent over time — with refresh and provenance discipline.
- [llm-eval](./.agents/skills/ai/llm-eval/SKILL.md) — Design LLM evaluation harnesses — benchmark design, model comparison, automated evals — with reproducible scoring, confidence intervals, and regression detection.
- [llm-fine-tuning](./.agents/skills/ai/llm-fine-tuning/SKILL.md) — Fine-tune LLMs — LoRA, QLoRA, full fine-tuning, data preparation, evaluation, deployment — with reproducibility, efficiency, and safety controls.
- [llmops](./.agents/skills/ai/llmops/SKILL.md) — LLMOps (deployment, monitoring, A/B testing, prompt management, cost optimization, evaluation pipelines)
- [localization](./.agents/skills/cms/localization/SKILL.md) — Design internationalization (i18n) and localization (l10n) — string management, locale handling, RTL support, cultural adaptation — so the product works across languages and regions.
- [lockfile-maintenance](./.agents/skills/skill-dev/lockfile-maintenance/SKILL.md) — Maintain the skills lockfile by detecting missing, stale, extra, or mismatched skill entries and updating hashes only after the corresponding SKILL.md files are resolved.
- [make-project](./.agents/skills/project/make-project/SKILL.md) — Use when the user wants a new board in GitHub Projects, or another skill needs one — create the project, wire its fields, and preserve tracker semantics.
- [math-computation-reproducible](./.agents/skills/math/math-computation-reproducible/SKILL.md) — Make mathematical computations reproducible — SymPy, Mathematica, Magma, Sage, Julia — with versioned environments (Docker/Conda/Nix), scripts, and result archival.
- [math-computational](./.agents/skills/math/math-computational/SKILL.md) — Solve numerical and symbolic math problems (root finding, integration, ODEs, symbolic manipulation) with stable algorithms and explicit error analysis.
- [math-cryptography](./.agents/skills/math/math-cryptography/SKILL.md) — Analyse cryptographic constructions — symmetric, asymmetric, hashing, MACs, zero-knowledge — with security reductions, hardness assumptions, and attack analysis.
- [math-formal-proof](./.agents/skills/math/math-formal-proof/SKILL.md) — Develop formal mathematical proofs in proof assistants (Lean 4, Coq, Isabelle, Agda) with literate programming, tactic-driven construction, and verification.
- [math-grant-structure](./.agents/skills/math/math-grant-structure/SKILL.md) — Structure mathematics grant proposals (NSF, ERC, Simons, MSCA) — aims, broader impacts, budget, timeline, reviewer expectations — with concrete templates.
- [math-linear-algebra](./.agents/skills/math/math-linear-algebra/SKILL.md) — Solve and analyse linear algebra problems — matrix decompositions (LU, QR, SVD, eigendecomposition), linear systems, and applications in ML, graphics, and optimisation.
- [math-literature-track](./.agents/skills/math/math-literature-track/SKILL.md) — Track mathematics literature across arXiv, MathSciNet, zbMATH, journal alerts, and citation graphs to keep a researcher current without drowning in papers.
- [math-optimization](./.agents/skills/math/math-optimization/SKILL.md) — Formulate and solve optimization problems (linear, convex, non-convex, combinatorial) — model, choose solver, verify optimality, report sensitivity.
- [math-paper-collaboration](./.agents/skills/math/math-paper-collaboration/SKILL.md) — Manage mathematical paper collaboration — Overleaf / GitHub / arXiv integration, citation tracking, version control, reproducible computation links, and co-author coordination.
- [math-presentation-beamer](./.agents/skills/math/math-presentation-beamer/SKILL.md) — Design mathematics presentations — Beamer slides with TikZ diagrams, colour accessibility, speaker notes, and audience-level adjustments — for seminars, conferences, or lectures.
- [math-probability-models](./.agents/skills/math/math-probability-models/SKILL.md) — Build probability models — distributions, stochastic processes (Markov, Brownian, Poisson), inference — with explicit assumptions and sanity checks.
- [math-pure-proofs](./.agents/skills/math/math-pure-proofs/SKILL.md) — Write and verify pure-math proofs (number theory, algebra, analysis, combinatorics) with rigorous step-by-step reasoning and explicit proof strategies.
- [math-teaching-problem-set](./.agents/skills/math/math-teaching-problem-set/SKILL.md) — Design and grade math problem sets and exams — difficulty progression, rubric, anti-cheating variants, accessibility, and LaTeX layout.
- [mcp-server](./.agents/skills/foundation/mcp-server/SKILL.md) — Define an MCP server to connect dynamic context (issues, PRs, traces, docs) to the quirk flow, enabling agent access to external data sources securely.
- [microservices](./.agents/skills/backend/microservices/SKILL.md) — Design microservice architectures — service decomposition, inter-service communication, data ownership, resilience patterns — with explicit boundaries and failure isolation.
- [mlops](./.agents/skills/ai/mlops/SKILL.md) — MLOps (feature stores, model registry, data versioning, pipeline orchestration, monitoring, retraining)
- [mobile](./.agents/skills/frontend/mobile/SKILL.md) — Shape mobile projects around device constraints, platform seams, offline behavior, and push notifications — with explicit performance and resilience boundaries for React Native, Expo, and Capacitor.
- [multimodal-prompting](./.agents/skills/ai/multimodal-prompting/SKILL.md) — Multimodal prompting (vision, audio, video, image generation, vision-language models)
- [networking](./.agents/skills/networking/networking/SKILL.md) — Design and analyze network infrastructure — TCP/IP, routing, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs, network security — with explicit assumptions about latency, bandwidth, and failure modes.
- [networking-protocols](./.agents/skills/networking/networking-protocols/SKILL.md) — Analyze network protocols — packet formats, handshakes, congestion control, routing, and transport behavior — with explicit timing and failure assumptions.
- [networking-security](./.agents/skills/networking/networking-security/SKILL.md) — Design network security — segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, TLS, authentication, and threat boundaries — with explicit trust zones.
- [nextjs](./.agents/skills/frontend/nextjs/SKILL.md) — Shape Next.js projects around routes, server/client seams, and data flow that stay deep rather than tangled.
- [observability](./.agents/skills/foundation/observability/SKILL.md) — Define the logs, metrics, traces, and alerts needed to understand a system in production — with SLIs, SLOs, dashboards, alert rules, and incident runbooks.
- [os-kernel](./.agents/skills/os/os-kernel/SKILL.md) — Design and analyze operating system internals — process management, memory management, file systems, scheduling, system calls, concurrency — with explicit resource accounting and failure boundaries.
- [os-memory](./.agents/skills/os/os-memory/SKILL.md) — Design operating system memory systems — virtual memory, paging, allocation, swapping, and protection — with explicit resource accounting and locality assumptions.
- [os-processes](./.agents/skills/os/os-processes/SKILL.md) — Design operating system process management — scheduling, signals, process states, concurrency, and inter-process communication — with explicit isolation boundaries.
- [payments](./.agents/skills/integrations/payments/SKILL.md) — Design payment flows as a high-trust seam with explicit failure, reconciliation, webhooks, idempotency, PCI DSS, and rollback posture — with Stripe, Adyen, or equivalent.
- [performance-testing](./.agents/skills/qa/performance-testing/SKILL.md) — Design and execute performance tests — load, stress, soak, spike — to validate latency, throughput, and resource consumption under realistic conditions.
- [physics-astro](./.agents/skills/physics/physics-astro/SKILL.md) — Model astrophysical systems — stellar structure, orbital dynamics, cosmology, gravitational waves — with physical scales, order-of-magnitude estimates, and scaling laws.
- [physics-career-postdoc](./.agents/skills/physics/physics-career-postdoc/SKILL.md) — Navigate physics career transitions — postdoc applications, faculty applications, letters of recommendation, research statements, teaching statements, grant applications (NSF CAREER, DOE, ERC, Simons), and negotiation.
- [physics-classical](./.agents/skills/physics/physics-classical/SKILL.md) — Solve classical mechanics problems — Newton's laws, Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, rigid body, orbital — with free-body diagrams, energy accounting, and dimensional checks.
- [physics-data-analysis-root](./.agents/skills/physics/physics-data-analysis-root/SKILL.md) — Analyse experimental physics data with ROOT, pandas, uproot, NumPy — calibration, systematic errors, statistical inference, result archival — with reproducible scripts.
- [physics-experimental-notebook](./.agents/skills/physics/physics-experimental-notebook/SKILL.md) — Maintain experimental physics lab notebooks — measurements, calibration, error analysis, FAIR data principles, reproducibility — with digital and physical structure.
- [physics-literature-search](./.agents/skills/physics/physics-literature-search/SKILL.md) — Track physics literature — arXiv (hep-th, cond-mat, astro-ph, gr-qc, quant-ph, nucl-th, physics.*), INSPIRE-HEP, NASA ADS, Web of Science, citation alerts — with domain filters.
- [physics-quantum](./.agents/skills/physics/physics-quantum/SKILL.md) — Model quantum systems (states, operators, measurement, entanglement) and perform calculations using Dirac notation, with checks against limits and known results.
- [physics-reproducibility-archive](./.agents/skills/physics/physics-reproducibility-archive/SKILL.md) — Make physics research reproducible and archive it — Zenodo DOI, GitHub + container (Docker/Apptainer), data preservation, code review, and open-science compliance for journals and funders.
- [physics-simulation-setup](./.agents/skills/physics/physics-simulation-setup/SKILL.md) — Set up reproducible physics simulations — Monte Carlo (GEANT4), molecular dynamics (LAMMPS), DFT (VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO), quantum dynamics (QuTiP) — with containers, parameter files, and verification.
